From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, Emma Harris <emma@acme.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orbitcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Critical-path + Dependency Deconflict for QBR (product & eng)

Team —

We have the leadership QBR in two weeks. I pulled together a focused view on the product and engineering critical path that I want us to lock today/tomorrow so we don’t have last-minute scope whiplash. Attached: QBR-critical-path-sheet.xlsx and dependency-matrix.csv (current as of this morning).

High-level asks (please read, then reply with concise commitments):
- Owners: mark the single owner for each checklist row in the spreadsheet and confirm in reply. (deadline: EOD Thu 2026-08-06)
- Blockers: call out anything that will stop a GA decision (e.g., storage e2e perf, model quantization regression, infra autoscale behavior). If you say "none", add a one-line rationale.
- External dependencies: Emma / Sanjay — confirm partner infra readiness (region parity and network peering) or give a firm rollback option.

Notes from my quick pass:
- Onboarding flow for the new model variant (m2-optimized) is on the critical path because it changes the KV cache warming window; we need integration testing in the dedicated pool (karthik).
- Launch window is still targeted for the week of 2026-08-24 but we must lock rollback triggers and canary sizes now.
- Shipping the analytics hook (for token-level cost breakdown) can be cut to a follow-up patch if infra and model pass smoke tests; but the rollout policy must be in place.

Please reply with three short bullets: owner / current status (green/amber/red) / next milestone (date). I will consolidate and route an escalation if any red items remain after EOD Thu.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR-critical-path-sheet.xlsx (xlsx), dependency-matrix.csv (csv)

Rachel — quick status from infra/serving side: 

- m2-optimized onboarding: Owner: karthik_iyer / Status: amber / Next milestone: 2026-08-09 (integration test in dedicated pool, followed by 48h performance window).
  - Action: I need a hard sign-off from Emma on network peering and VLAN routing for the dedicated pool to run full KV-warm tests. Sanjay, can you confirm by 2026-08-06 EOD?
- Autoscale behavior under mixed-burst traffic: Owner: tessa_morgan / Status: amber / Next milestone: 2026-08-11 (canary exercise with synthetic traffic).
- Token-level analytics hook: Owner: lauren_bishop / Status: green/low-risk / Next milestone: 2026-08-20 (deferred GA but shipping internal flags).

Blockers and mitigation suggestions:
- Known blocker: a regression in the quantized attention kernel surfaced in last night’s nightly on a 16GB GPU image. If we can’t reproduce with the exact production kernel, contingency is to pin to v1.9 kernels and delay m2-optimized rollout by one week.
- Contingency: we can reduce canary size and split canary by region (us/eu) for gradual confidence while the kernel issue is investigated.

I attached the dependency-matrix.csv (updated) — I pushed a column for "hard dependency" vs "soft dependency".

—Karthik
Sr. Eng Manager, Serving Runtime
